---
title: "Week 11 · Readable code, defensible results"
---

Follow Week 11 in two parts:

1. [Meeting 1 · Read the pipeline](week-11-meeting-1.html): trace events, name checkpoints and explain summaries (Core 1/2).
2. [Meeting 2 · Reuse rules with contracts](week-11-meeting-2.html): implement the two functions and choose tests (Core 4/7/8), with selective Guided AI review.

Both meetings retain their 75-minute classroom structure and five-minute
individual exits. Nothing in these pages is collected or graded. The approved
syllabus, workload guide and Blackboard remain authoritative.

## A first 30-minute recovery session {#route}

Choose a stopping point within about 30 minutes and resume later. This is an
untested stopping budget, not a completion promise; it counts within the whole
week's approved 90–120-minute practice budget.

1. Read the [prerequisites](week-11-meeting-1.html#before-start) and run the [setup](week-11-meeting-1.html#setup).
2. Try the [identity prediction](week-11-meeting-1.html#bridge) and trace the [checkpoint table](week-11-meeting-1.html#checkpoints).
3. Inspect the [issue summary](week-11-meeting-1.html#summary): explain its row meaning and counts.
4. Begin the [function contract](week-11-meeting-2.html#vector-function); compare the hidden explanation and mark where to resume.

For the full route, follow each meeting in order. Core 1/2/4/7/8 remain the
selected practice; Guided 3/9/10 are selective, and Extension 5/6 are optional.
See [practice and possible solutions](week-11-meeting-2.html#practice).
